headlines.title: Fed Governor Waller sees December hike likely, opens door to possible half-point increase
headlines.summary: Listen up — a Fed governor just put a 50-basis-point hike on the table the day before CPI drops. That's the tape-stopper right there. Every rate-sensitive sector from housing to tech to the long bond is repricing in real time, and the stock rebound already stalled on this news per Bloomberg's wrap.

headlines.title: Anthropic sets IPO price range of $70 to $78, looks to start trading Nov. 19, sources say
headlines.summary: A trillion-dollar AI name hitting the tape next week is the biggest sentiment test for the entire AI trade since the sector got rocked last week. If this thing prices well, it's a green light for beaten-down AI names; if it stumbles, the whole complex gets another leg down. Every hyperscaler, chip name, and cloud play has skin in this game.

headlines.title: Brent crude falls below $90 for first time since August on Iran war de-escalation hopes
headlines.summary: Brent cracking below $90 for the first time since August is a big deal — it's a tax cut for every consumer and business on the planet, and it takes pressure off the inflation print coming tomorrow. Energy stocks get hit, airlines and transports catch a bid, and the geopolitical risk premium that's been baked into everything starts coming out of the market.
